about_the_game:
If you're not careful, you might noclip and enter a place called "The Backrooms". A place like never before seen with mind bending levels that makes you question if this is real.

The Gameplay:

The gameplay consists of traversing through different levels trying to find a way out of this confusing reality while some levels might have the living things called "Entities".

Levels:

The game has 15+ levels that have their own theme which, based on what levels you traverse through and what you as the player do, you will get a different ending

Level 0 (The Lobby)

Level 1 (Habitable Zone)

Level 2 (Utility Halls)

Level 3 (Electrical Station)

Level 4 (Abandoned Office)

Level 5 (Terror Hotel)

And many more...

Entities:

Skin Stealer:

-It's either hungry or not, but when it is it will disguise itself like another human being and try to lure other people towards it so that it can make you the next meal.

Smiler:

-A grinning creature that will kill you if you move too fast.

Window:

-A seemingly normal window that is pitch black which can grab you and drag you into the window.

Anethikas:

-A black shadowy figure that will hunt you down until it finds you. This entity has 2 versions which are the normal version and goliath version.

Animation:

-A creature that looks like a character from a stop motion animation that is aggressive at night.

Controls:

Press the F button to turn on your flashlight

Hold Shift to sprint

Press E to interact with different objects
